title: Luxuriously Sweet Russian Rice Pilaf
description: A sweet and gooey Russian dish featuring paella rice, perfect for midnight cravings, this recipe is kosher-friendly and cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron. It combines the richness of rice, sugar, and butter for a truly indulgent treat.
instructions: Rinse the paella rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear, then set aside.
In a large kazan cauldron, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds to the cauldron and cook, stirring frequently, until they are lightly toasted.
Add the granulated sugar to the cauldron and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is caramelized.
Add the rinsed paella rice to the cauldron, stirring to coat the rice in the sugar and butter mixture.
Add the water, raisins, and cinnamon to the cauldron, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the cauldron, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the pilaf is cooking, toast the white bread slices until they are lightly browned.
To serve, place a portion of the pilaf onto each toasted bread slice and serve immediately.
